g.title: parent
g.text: Current Aiterm child capture / parent delivery and recovery

g.title: request
g.text: request: freeze parent + optional execution source

g.title: before
g.text: beforeChange: previous answer must be captured

g.title: close
g.text: manager close: stop timer / new prepare

g.title: record
g.text: filename + ID / ENOENT vs invalid / answer framing

g.title: watch
g.text: watch fixed session / launch / operation / cursor
observe child completion; read genuine answer

g.title: unknown
g.text: retain original diagnosis; no body replay

g.title: ready
g.text: release child claim; next child input may proceed

g.title: watch->ready
g.text: observe failure saved as error notice

g.title: sending
g.text: Steer owns vendor queue / hook / output

g.title: result
g.text: archive result; status projects Codex hook state
receipt is not parent work completion

g.title: retain
g.text: old owner directory removal separately guarded
best-effort cleanup is not delivery replay

g.title: recover
g.text: Other owner: heartbeat + PID + birth identity
rename original record to one recovery owner

g.title: route
g.text: waiting → watch; ready → verify then deliver
private requires source / graph recovery admission
